message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 272, "amount_cents": 8656}, {"order_id": 274, "amount_cents": 1382}, {"order_id": 275, "amount_cents": 2304}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 272, "amount_cents": 8656}, {"order_id": 274, "amount_cents": 1382}, {"order_id": 275, "amount_cents": 2304}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I need to confirm the refunds table matches what Alpha reported. I'll pull the refunds table first.
The refunds table matches the three refunds Alpha reported, so I can proceed. Next I need the list of orders to identify the customers to pay.
The refunds table matches Alpha's report exactly, so I can proceed. The orders name three customers: acme, birch, and cobalt. I'll get each one's net balance, starting with acme.
Acme's net balance came back as 62169 cents. Acme has orders totaling 36208 + 25961 = 62169 and no refunds, so the figure checks out. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
Acme and birch both match my hand-check against their orders and refunds. Cobalt is the last customer, so I'll get its net balance before recording any payouts.

Cobalt's figure checks out: orders 272 and 275 total 35333, minus refunds 8656 and 2304 gives 24373. All three balances match my hand-checks and the refunds table matches Alpha's report, so I'll record the payouts, starting with acme.
Acme's payout of 62169 recorded successfully. Birch's orders total 29142 + 20980 = 50122, minus the 1382 refund on order 274, gives 48740, which matches net_balance. Recording birch's payout next.

Birch's payout is recorded. The only remaining customer is cobalt, whose net balance I already checked at 24373 cents, matching orders 272 and 275 minus refunds 8656 and 2304. Recording cobalt's payout now.

All three customers have been paid, and each recorded payout matches its net balance and my hand-check. The refunds table matched Alpha's report before any payouts were recorded, so the batch is complete.
